position_validity: GPS fix>=3, EKF horizontal absolute position flag16, non-placeholder lat/lon
time_basis: Both vehicle boot time and reception wall time must span>=2s; position gaps must be<=0.5s on both. Latest state/GPS/EKF ages checked for each sample.
invalid_or_stale_policy: reset dwell; leave state unknown; never interpolate/fill missing samples
qualification_limit: Sample-based observational contract only; no claim of exact continuous physical state between messages.
bounded_response: If not achieved within30s of accepted destination, record failure and LAND without bypass
post_arrival_observation: Observe at least5s extra in GUIDED before LAND; no new destination
waypoint_indicator: Record any received MISSION_ITEM_REACHED separately; normal GUID_OPTIONS0 position submode does not use the waypoint-notification branch in inspected source
